notes: Fixed the known Agent-screen bug where tapping the Claude Code or Antigravity tabs sometimes did nothing: tabs went dead while an agent install ran in the background (including installs started from Settings, where no progress card was visible), and a tap that could not be carried out was silently swallowed with no message. Every tap now either acts immediately or explains itself with a toast - the install progress card is always visible while an install runs, tapping during another install says which one to wait for, and a switch blocked by a running task is announced instead of leaving the screen blank. Viewing an installed-but-not-yet-active agent shows an explanatory card instead of an empty space. No other behavior changed; the three existing agents work exactly as before. Same signing key - installs directly over v1.0.17 with one tap.
